blurb: Central Florida Dance Center offers dance training in ballet, tap, jazz, hip hop, acro, lyrical, contemporary, and more. They provide programs for ages 2 and up, including preschool classes, daytime intensive programs, competitive teams, and summer camps. The studio emphasizes creativity, technique, and performance opportunities including competitions and conventions.
